column1: # Lua-CDP CHERI baseline column — PREDICTIONS, committed BEFORE the runs.
# The CHERI half of the fair comparison for xlang/lua-cdp/. The SAME shim source
# as the Capstone column (../shims/*.c) is compiled purecap and run as an
# ordinary CheriBSD process under the three revocation configs. Only the
# capability mechanism differs; the workload is identical.
# Keys match ../capstone/rows.tsv. classify.py requires a NUMERIC key (col 1);
# col 2's basename is the purecap binary.
# Every row is a temporal cross-domain UAF, so the prediction is uniform and
# follows the mruby CHERI column's measured pattern for direct-free / GC-free
# UAFs (../../cheri/rows.tsv rows 1, 12):
#   spatial  MISS   revocation OFF: the freed block is still in-bounds, so the
#                   stale access succeeds — CHERI spatial safety cannot see a
#                   temporal UAF.
#   async    MISS   revocation ON, async quarantine (the DEPLOYED default): the
#                   sweep has not run at the contract point, so the capability is
#                   not yet revoked and the stale access completes. THIS IS THE
#                   HEADLINE — the default config does not catch it synchronously.
#   eager    SWEEP  revocation ON, revoke on every free: the free revokes
#                   immediately, so the stale access faults (SIGPROT). This is the
#                   config that maps onto Capstone's revoke-on-free.
# Taxonomy (classify.py, from exit code): SYNC = fault under spatial;
#   SWEEP(async|eager) = fault only with revocation; MISS = completed.
